description: This file defines a scraper class 'Reishunger' for extracting ingredients, equipment, and instructions from a recipe webpage, specifically tailored for the German site 'reishunger.de'. It inherits from an abstract scraper and uses HTML parsing to locate and process recipe data.

classes.name: Reishunger
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe details from reishunger.de, including ingredients, equipment, and instructions.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname 'reishunger.de' for the target website.

methods.name: _filter_ingredients
methods.description: Parses the ingredients and equipment sections from the recipe page, distinguishing between food ingredients and kitchen equipment based on headings.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Returns the list of ingredients extracted from the recipe page.

methods.name: equipment
methods.description: Returns the list of kitchen equipment items extracted from the recipe page.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts and compiles the step-by-step cooking instructions from the recipe page.
